what: The hold protocol (operator skill section 6): what an operator must say and run at a hold, and what it must never do. Enumerated by tests/test_conformance.py against the engine's texts and by integrations/conformance.py against a harness's skill rendering or appendix. A runner asserts the set is not empty.
skill_must_say: Which do you choose, and why? I will not choose for you.
Do not read the prompt text yourself when a

relay.command: stringency review --verdict accept --hold HOLD --reason "the floor is right" --attest

never: the operator edits a delegate's answer
